summary.scope: Exploratory authored local policies. No model is trained. Receiver imports only fresh joint/ray roles, ordinal order, direction actions, component promises and interior-turn refinements. Original edge pairings and position words are withheld.
summary.defaults: Closed-area goal, finite straight passages, shared uncalibrated ordinal gap. Proposed bridges and sample gap sizes are defaults/assumptions, not observed source geometry.
summary.feedback: Message-only structural critic. Previous violated edge pairs influence later local pairing. A violated complete joint-opposition inventory can trigger wider outer gap defaults, preserving corners. Policy schedule also changes gap/default emphasis. Teacher edge comparison occurs afterward and never chooses the best attempt.
summary.limits: Two/four-fold action evidence uses explicit native quarter-turn interpretation; arbitrary n equal angular partitions are not inferred. General diagonal crossing, fine within-quadrant angle and curve/tangent inference remain open. Symmetry concerns undirected visible passages, not generating flow.
